description: Georgia motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: A Georgia Class MP motorcycle instructional permit holder may not
options: Ride after dark, carry passengers, or use limited-access highways
Ride without a licensed rider on the same motorcycle
questions.explanation: The Class MP permit allows riding except after dark, with passengers, or on expressways and interstates.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in Georgia?
questions.explanation: Georgia helmet law: all riders and passengers.
questions.remember: Georgia helmets: all riders and passengers.

provenance.manual: Georgia Drivers Manual | Department of Driver Services

questions.q: What does Georgia law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
questions.explanation: Georgia: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.

provenance.manual: Motorcycle Operators Manual | Georgia Department of Driver Services

questions.q: What does Georgia require for a motorcycle rider's eye protection?
options: Required unless the motorcycle has a windshield
questions.explanation: Georgia: eye protection is required unless the motorcycle has a windshield.
questions.remember: Georgia eyewear: required unless there is a windshield.

questions.q: In Georgia, what is the youngest age for a motorcycle learner's permit?
questions.explanation: Georgia issues a motorcycle permit at 16 years at the earliest.
questions.remember: Georgia motorcycle permit: 16 years at the earliest.

provenance.manual: Georgia Drivers Manual | Department of Driver Services
